title: PyTorch-Nightly PyPI Package Compromised with Malicious Dependency

title: Clearview AI code repository misconfiguration exposes production credentials and video samples
summary: A misconfigured code repository allowed unauthorized user registration, giving external researchers access to production credentials, cloud storage keys, and video samples. The exposed assets included sensitive data linked to the AI system.

title: Researchers replicate machine translation services and transfer adversarial attacks
summary: Academic researchers successfully replicated commercial translation APIs and used the extraction to craft adversarial inputs causing targeted translation errors. The work demonstrates model extraction and adversarial vulnerability.

title: Palo Alto Networks security team demonstrates evasion of deep learning malware detector
summary: Researchers built a replica deep learning model for malware traffic detection and crafted adversarial HTTP samples to successfully evade it. The finding highlights vulnerability to adversarial perturbation.

title: LLM Application Frameworks Allow Remote Code Execution via Prompting
summary: Frameworks like langchain and boxcars.ai allow direct query execution through LLMs, enabling remote code execution or SQL injection via prompt inputs. Researchers demonstrated that unauthorized actions could be triggered through conversational input.

summary: Samsung engineers entered proprietary source code and internal meeting notes into ChatGPT during routine work tasks. The disclosure led the company to restrict employee access to external generative AI services.

title: Code Execution in MathGPT via Prompt Injection
summary: Researchers demonstrated that prompt injection against the MathGPT application could steer GPT-3 into generating unauthorized executable Python code. The demonstration highlighted risks in applications that directly execute model-generated code.
